test.result: 64 tests passed; Ruff and mypy passed.

implemented: Threshold policy must be frozen before the cohort start and is content-addressed.
Rolling net alpha, slippage, fill coverage, and drift are checked against frozen thresholds.
Missing evidence, non-finite metrics, and insufficient observations fail closed to PAUSE.
Persistent severe net-alpha breaches escalate to RETIRE; pause and retirement remain latched.
Returned alarm events are immutable and contain reasons, policy identity, and observation digest; no strategy parameter mutation is exposed.
Optional DurableJournal persistence writes alarms to its hash chain before returning and restores event IDs, breach counters, and latched state after restart.
A failed journal append does not advance monitor state, allowing safe retry of the same observation.
ForwardSessionRunner binds rolling observations to matching closed LIVE_PAPER sessions and persists alarms in the same journal.
A policy-latched PAUSE or RETIRE withholds new/increasing exposure in later sessions while allowing explicit REDUCE/CLOSE decisions.
blockers: A trusted scheduled rolling-metric adapter does not yet generate observations after every forward paper session; the recording API is caller-triggered.
Production thresholds, trusted identity roots, alarm delivery, and prospective market-cohort evidence are not configured or verified.
